reference._why: Plain torch, outside the port package (the harness refuses a reference resolving inside vllm_neuron). Out-of-place index_put over boolean-selected valid rows, merged in fp32 over the cache-dtype-quantized payload — no clamp redirect, no index_select, no where, no in-place op — while the triad's fallback is the incumbent clamp-redirect masked-scatter composition (_torch_kv_cache_write): two independent spellings of the declared write.

_tolerance_derivation: BIT-EXACT obligation (LD-79 grep row: casts-reproduce-_masked_scatter_rows-bitwise): rtol=0.0 atol=0.0 on EVERY case — allclose at 0/0 is exact equality. The harness compares returned tensors in fp32; float8_e4m3fn→float32 is injective, so fp32 equality ⟺ byte equality. randn at unit scale cannot mint fp8 NaN/Inf (max |x| ≪ the 448 e4m3fn saturation bound), so the NaN≠NaN allclose edge cannot fire. Fixed in the sealed prereg BEFORE any measurement; NEVER widened — a post-hoc widening would turn the fallback into a lying discriminator for the accuracy loop (node contract).
_domain_notes: The op RETURNS the written cache (Z0 D1 contract completion: the harness grades RETURNED tensors — torch.as_tensor(None) crashes every leg — and every call site discards the return; the traced-path in-place threading is the HOP operand_output_aliases, independent of the python return). Slot ids are unique by construction (arange) in every writing case; all-sentinel-skip is deterministically all -1 (randint in [-1,0)), duplicate sentinel rows all no-op with identical bytes. NO declared case both validly writes slot 0 and carries a sentinel row: that zone is order-unspecified in the INCUMBENT itself (index_put_ with duplicate destinations after the clamp-to-0 redirect) and is excluded from the op contract — F-13 row provenance gives every real token its own slot.
_uncovered_by_harness: The harness passes tensors positionally and scalars via kwargs only; tensor keyword args are inexpressible — valid_mask is therefore NOT covered here and is graded instead by the committed probe numerics/probe_kv_cache_write_supplementary.py (which reads rtol/atol FROM this declaration): valid_mask mask-skip (mixed and all-False), mixed -1/valid slot vectors (valid ids unique, none targeting slot 0 while a sentinel row is present — the recorded contract zone), duplicate sentinel rows, the full per-class width sweep {64,128,224,512,672,896,1344,2688} with BITWISE post-call cache-byte compare (uint8 view), rows dtype sweep {fp8 identity, f32 cast, bf16 cast}, int32 slot_ids, and the eager-simulator in-place contract (after the PUBLIC op on the kernel leg, the CALLER's cache object carries the written bytes — the D-copyback). A recorded harness-vocabulary limit, never an absorbed one (LD-75 precedent).
